recoveryTime.description: Unit: MINUTES. sync.py's recovery_time_h field divides by 60 to store hours (CLAUDE.md unit-quirk table).

acwrFactorPercent.description: Consumed directly as acw_pct (no conversion — matches the acwrFactorPercent name/unit exactly).

hrvFactorPercent.description: NOT currently consumed. sync.py incorrectly reads a nonexistent 'hrvStatus' key expecting a BALANCED/UNBALANCED/POOR enum (see bug #58) — this field and hrvFactorFeedback are the real HRV-related data here, but they're a 0-100 contribution score + feedback phrase (e.g. "GOOD"), not that enum. That enum lives in get_hrv_data instead (already correctly synced separately as hrv.status).

hrvFactorFeedback.description: String, observed value: GOOD. Shares vocabulary with other *FactorFeedback fields (acwrFactorFeedback, recoveryTimeFactorFeedback, sleepHistoryFactorFeedback, stressHistoryFactorFeedback) — full enum range unconfirmed from a single sample. See bug #58.

title: Training readiness (get_training_readiness)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_training_readiness(date) as a list (single-element in samples observed). Consumed by sync_training_readiness.

Verified against: 2026-07-24 (activity day), 2026-07-25 (rest day). Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true) — Garmin adding new fields is not a breaking change; a listed field disappearing or changing type is.
